summary_en: Aisan Industry authorized acquisition of up to 2,700,000 shares (4.7% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of ¥7.0 billion via ToSTNeT-3, with immediate execution on November 17, 2026, followed by cancellation of all acquired shares on November 30, 2026. The program supports the company's medium-term capital efficiency and shareholder return initiatives.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On November 16, 2026, Aisan Industry's board of directors authorized the acquisition of up to 2,700,000 treasury shares, representing 4.7% of issued shares excluding treasury stock (57,451,110 shares as of September 30, 2026), for a maximum of ¥7.0 billion. The company will execute the purchase via ToSTNeT-3 (off-market trading on the Tokyo Stock Exchange) on November 17, 2026, and cancel all acquired shares on November 30, 2026.

The buyback program is designed to enhance capital efficiency and strengthen shareholder returns as part of Aisan Industry's medium-term management plan for fiscal 2025–2027. The company stated in its May 28, 2025 announcement of the medium-term plan that it would flexibly implement treasury share acquisitions to support these strategic objectives. All shares acquired under this authorization will be immediately and fully cancelled, reducing the outstanding share count.
